About

Developer mindset. SEO discipline.

Bilal Ahmed is a senior web developer and SEO specialist with 8+ years of experience building responsive, search-optimised WordPress websites and turning organic visibility into measurable business results.

Clean design is nice. Clean design that ranks, loads fast and converts is better. His work pairs hands-on front-end development with data-led search strategy: WordPress, Elementor, WooCommerce, HTML5, CSS3, responsive layouts, Core Web Vitals, technical audits, on-page optimisation, content planning, internal linking and ethical link-building.

He builds and maintains websites for businesses across Pakistan, KSA, the UK, UAE, US and Europe, from concept to deployment and ongoing support.
